subject: PIA Template: Greenfield Health — Response plan and deliverables
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greenfield Health PIA template (please review)

Hi Rishi / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our procurement and privacy review, I've attached Greenfield Health's PIA template (latest version). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a completed response and supporting evidence (SOC 2, data flows, retention policy) within 5 business days? Key areas we will evaluate are: data categories processed, cross-border transfers, retention limits, and DPIA mitigations for profiling/automated decisioning.

Attachment: Greenfield_PIA_Template_v3.docx (20KB stub)

If you prefer, we can schedule a short walkthrough of the PIA next week — happy to join.

Thanks,
Sarah Nguyen
Privacy Program Manager
Greenfield Health

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield Health PIA template (please review)

Hi Sarah,

Appreciate the PIA template — we received it and I'll own the response. High-level plan:
- Today/Tomorrow: internal review and evidence pull (SOC 2 artifacts, data flow diagram, retention schedules). Monica + Laura will own control and legal questions.
- By Mon 03/01 EOD PT: deliver a completed PIA response draft plus supporting attachments.

A couple of quick clarifying questions that will affect some answers:
1) Scope: will the PIA cover only the hosted Redwood API usage (our hosted inference) or also any Dedicated/Private deployments you may run?
2) Retention: do you need us to commit to a custom retention window per account beyond our standard policy?
3) Data categories: is PHI present in the sample data or only pseudonymized/hashed tokens? If PHI is in scope we will escalate to our security/compliance team and outline our HIPAA support.

If helpful, Monica and I can do a 30-minute call Friday to walk through the template — otherwise we will proceed with the questions above and produce a draft for your review.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield Health PIA template (please review)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick reply and helpful plan. To clarify:
- Scope: initially only the hosted Redwood API (we will evaluate Dedicated later).
- Retention: we have a preferred 90-day retention for conversational logs; if not possible, please flag the minimal configurable window and any limitations.
- Data categories: sample includes limited PHI (name + hashed MRN). We expect the vendor to document safeguards and whether they sign a DPA / Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA where applicable.

We'd prefer the draft by Monday 03/01 EOD PT. No call required unless you have follow-ups. Also, please include the relevant SOC 2 report and any executed SCCs or template SCC language you rely on.

Regards,
Sarah

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Greenfield Health PIA template (please review)

Hi Sarah,

Please find attached our completed PIA response draft and supporting evidence. Summary of deliverables included in the attached PDF:
- Completed PIA questionnaire: each question answered with references to controls or product features.
- Data flow summary: high-level diagram identifying flows to cache, KV store, and long-term logs (included as figure 2).
- Retention: our hosted default is 180 days, but we document a configurable retention policy and can offer a 90-day option via an account setting and contractual addendum (see retention clause reference).
- PHI/HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads on Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted we treat PHI as "sensitive personal data" and will sign a DPA that includes appropriate technical and organizational measures. We recommend a BAA for PHI. Monica has flagged the required HIPAA steps in section 4.
- Cross-border transfers / SCCs: we provided our standard SCC execution note and the locations of our EU/US processing nodes.
- Evidence: SOC 2 report (redacted) and a runbook excerpt showing incident response timelines are attached.

Attachments (stubs):
- redwood_pia_response_Greenfield-20260301.pdf (9 pages, 120KB stub)
- SOC2-report-2025.pdf (redacted, 48 pages, stub)
- SCCs-execution-note.pdf (2 pages, stub)

Next steps: please review the draft and highlight any items requiring deeper evidence (e.g., full control narratives, encryption key lifecycle docs). If you want us to sign an addendum for 90-day retention, we can route that to legal; Laura is cc'd and will coordinate.

Happy to hop on a short sync if helpful — otherwise we'll wait for your feedback.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
